titre: Home ownership builds wealth, renters fall behind
resume: Not being able to buy a house limits how much wealth you and your descendants can build. A National Association of Realtors report found middle-income homeowners accumulated $122,100 in wealth by 2023 with 68% property appreciation since 2012; Lawrence Yun says a mortgage is forced savings giving homeowners about 40 times a renter's net worth. In 2022 renters spent 30% of income on rent and the owner-renter wealth gap grew 70% in three decades (Bremer Bank).
